answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
一个编号图 `Figure 2.20`、一行副标题、三个带填色横幅的面板(`A. Literacy`/`B. Numeracy`/`C. Adaptive problem solving`),共用一个位于顶部的图例(方块 `Unadjusted` + 菱形 `Adjusted`)。每个面板 32 个国家、竖排 90° 旋转标签、条形上叠加菱形点(约 192 个 marks),y 轴 0–80、只有横向网格线,轴标题 `Score-point difference` 写在最高刻度之上。`OECD average` 用浅蓝竖带+加粗标签突出,`Flemish Region (BE)`、`England (UK)` 标签为蓝色,`Poland*` 带脚注星号。三个面板各自按本面板的 unadjusted 值降序重排,国家顺序不一致。

## 定位一个值难在哪
以 `42` 为例:它是 A. Literacy 面板 Israel 的 Adjusted 菱形。要唯一定位需四个标签:图号/面板名 `A. Literacy`、类别 `Israel`、系列 `Adjusted`。图上没有任何数字,刻度间隔 10 分,5% 容差只有 ±2.1 分,只能靠像素在 40–45 间估读;而 Israel 在 B、C 面板同样有 ~34 的菱形,缺面板名就会串行。

## 不确定的
所有数值均为按轴估读,±2 分内无法确定;`75`、`70`、`65` 究竟落在 A 面板 Germany/Switzerland 还是 B/C 面板的同名条上无法分辨;菱形中心位置在条形阴影中略被遮挡;页面无 StatLink 行(可能被裁掉)。

heading.title: Differences in key information-processing skills, by parental education
heading.subtitle: Adjusted and unadjusted differences in average literacy, numeracy and adaptive problem solving scores between adults (highly educated parents minus low-educated parents)

axes.serves: all bars and all diamonds, in each of the three panels
country slots; order differs per panel

worked_example.why_hard: No printed value; ticks every 10 while 5% tolerance is ±2; diamond sits inside shaded bar.

components.evidence: black diamonds ('Adjusted') drawn on top of the light blue bars in every panel
one legend 'Unadjusted  Adjusted' above panel A governs all three panels
legend row sits between the subtitle and the 'A. Literacy' panel
three stacked panels A, B, C of the same bar+diamond chart
filled dark-blue banners 'A. Literacy', 'B. Numeracy', 'C. Adaptive problem solving'
horizontal rules at 10,20,...,80 across each panel; no vertical grid
3 panels x 32 countries x 2 series = about 192 marks
'OECD average' label in bold with a pale blue column behind it in each panel
pale blue vertical band spanning the plot height at the OECD average slot
country names such as 'Slovak Republic' set vertically, rotated 90 degrees
'Poland*' on the category axis; note reads '*Caution is required in interpreting results'
'Note: Adults aged 16-65...' and 'Source: Table A.2.12 (L, N, A) in Annex A.'
'Score-point difference' printed above the 80 tick at the top-left of each panel
bare ticks 0..80; scale word only in 'Score-point difference'
'Flemish Region (BE)' and 'England (UK)' tick labels printed in blue, others black
category labels 'Flemish Region (BE)', 'England (UK)' carry bracketed country codes

answer.hardest_step_why: 无任何数字,刻度间隔10分;值24的5%容差仅±1.2分,菱形只能像素估读,42与Israel邻近点也难分。

examples.quote: y axis ticks read 0,10,20,...,80 with no value labels on any bar or diamond
examples.why: 192个mark全靠估读,10分刻度下±1.2分容差不可达,需要按mark给出可达精度。

examples.quote: Panels banners 'A. Literacy', 'B. Numeracy', 'C. Adaptive problem solving'; Germany appears in all three
examples.why: 同一国名在三个面板各有一值,键必须含面板名,否则无法唯一定位。

examples.quote: legend: a square 'Unadjusted' and a diamond 'Adjusted'; diamonds drawn on top of the bars
examples.why: 同一轴上两种mark形状并存,值须记录读自条形还是菱形。

examples.quote: 'OECD average' in bold over a pale blue vertical band; 'England (UK)' label printed in blue
examples.why: 高亮与蓝色标签编码了聚合行与次国家实体,这些属性不在图例中。

examples.quote: 'Figure 2.20. Differences in key information-processing skills, by parental education' then a two-line subtitle; unit only as 'Score-point difference'
examples.why: 编号、标题、副标题、单位分处四处,需作为独立字段与位置生成。
